# Module: modal-customer.js

**Responsibility:** Customer detail/edit modal — open, close, toggle edit mode, save (`PUT /api/customers/:id`), and the placeholder P.I.S.T.A. chat panel.
**Location:** `ui_design/js/controllers/database/modal-customer.js`
**Depends on:** `state.js` (`currentData`, `API_BASE`, `orderCountMap`, `resolveLogoUrl`), `renderers-master-data.js` (`renderCustomers`, to refresh the table after save)
**Consumed by:** `databaseController.js` (side-effect import only, to register `window.*` handlers), `onclick` attributes generated by `renderers-master-data.js`

## Exports

None — all handlers are registered on `window`: `openCustomerModal`, `closeCustomerModal`, `handleModalBgClick`, `toggleModalEdit`, `saveModalCustomer`, `sendModalChat`.

## Key Concepts

- Same open/edit/save/mutate-in-place pattern as `modal-supplier.js` and `modal-product.js` — private local state (`modalCustomer`, `modalEditMode`), not shared.
- Reads `orderCountMap` (from `state.js`) to show the order-count badge and mention it in the seeded P.I.S.T.A. chat greeting.

## What is NOT here

- Supplier/Product/Order modals — see the sibling `modal-*.js` files
- Customer table rendering — see `renderers-master-data.js`
